headline: Public hearing on a proposed home at 103 Oswald Street, plus updates on zoning, land development, and comprehensive plan rules.
summary: Mohammed Qandil seeks approval to build a two-story home at 103 Oswald Street and asks for a dimensional variance for a side setback. Three workshops give status updates on the Zoning Ordinance, the Land Development and Subdivision Regulations, and the Comprehensive Plan, and no votes are taken on them.
items: Public hearing: Unified Development Review for 103 Oswald Street (AP 29 Lot 240), vote taken
Workshop: Zoning Ordinance update, no vote taken
Workshop: Land Development and Subdivision Regulations update, no vote taken
Workshop: Comprehensive Plan update, no vote taken

Unified Development Review (DPR)             (VOTE TAKEN) 
103 Oswald Street (AP 29 Lot 240) 
Mohammed Qandil seeks approval to construct a two -story, 2,300-square-foot home on a 6,154 +/ - sq ft 
lot of land, owned by Bermudez and Rojas Realty. Pursuant to RIGL §45-23-50.1, this proposal is subject 
to Unified Development Review as the applicant is requesting a Dimensional Variance under §410 -46 of 
the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance for minimum side setback of an accessory use.

these legislative updates and address inconsistencies, errors, and omissions in the existing Zoning

Comprehensive Plan Update 
The Planning & Redevelopment Department is updating the Comprehensive Plan to better align with 
community sentiment, recent updates to Rhode Island General Laws, and recent revisions to several 
elements of the State Guide Plan. This agenda item provides updates on the progress of the Comprehensive
